Update HPA rate limit configuration (#74)

* dev-sync: No change in chart, to resolve branch merge conflicts, ran
make command and created charts

* DEV-64397 updated docs

* DEV-65186: Update argus and collector cluster role for hpa discovery and
metric collection

* read_from_head removed

* Version updated

* Release files added

* DEV-64397 updated docs

* DEV-64397 updated docs

* DEV-64397 updated docs

* DEV-65186: added hpa discovery param

* DEV-64397 updated docs

* DEV-64397 updated docs

* Time accuracy milliseconds added to lm-logs

* Package created

* DEV-65940- added configurations for displayName with namespace and clusterName.

* DEV-65940-helm chart upgrade.

* Fluentd version updated for lm-logs

* Config updated

* DEV-67271: Made annotations and labels optional - user can provide their labels and annotations

* DEV-67271: values.yaml corrected

* DEV-65940- added comments in values.yaml file.

* DEV-67271: swapped if conditions so that empty collections values tends
to be ignored by CI tools like spinnaker hence mandatary labels and
annotations added outside and if condition only renders input
collections.

* DEV-67271: take mandatory annotation out from csc secret.yaml

* Set fleuntd logging level at system level to warm

* DEV-65940- committed latest helm charts.

* DEV-66427- added permission for metrics in collector clusterRole.

* DEV-66427- updated charts.

* DEV-66427- added 0.10.0-devel chart back

* DEV-66427- correct chart version.

* DEV-67271: pass on labels and annotations to the pod

* DEV-67271: rebuild charts after merging develop on pods label changes

* dev-release: rebuilt charts after merging develop

* dev-release: created configuration template yamls

* dev-release: marked charts for release

* dev-release: marked next devel version in develop branch

* dev-release: lm-logs auto resolve commit duplicated compression param

* dev-release: bump up argus image tag version to v5

* dev-release: Update config template with argus v5 tag and renamed folder
old to versioned

* Fix fluentd recursive logging bug

* improve readme docs

* dev-release: rebuilt the charts after synching develop

* Bugfix: re-enable daemon set to match all tolerations

* Merge pull request #65 in DEV/k8s-helm-charts from dev-release to develop
